repairs.value: Multiple flourishing lives can occupy different moral peaks without erasing objective error, because alternatives that reliably produce misery remain valleys rather than equally valid answers.
repairs.rationale: This complete condensation preserves Harris's peaks-and-valleys inference while clearly distinguishing moral pluralism from relativism.

repairs.value: Strongest feature: Harris uses the moral-landscape image precisely: incompatible flourishing lives may occupy several peaks, while misery-filled valleys preserve an intelligible distinction between good answers and objective failures. Principal limitation: The metaphor establishes conceptual compatibility between plural goods and moral truth, but does not independently show that well-being identifies every relevant peak or settles contested cases as valleys. Live burden: To extend this central bridge, Harris must give public criteria for comparing flourishing across incompatible lives, explain how they constrain disagreement, and address value conflicts without obvious misery. Locked score: The score of 87 appropriately rewards coherent reconciliation of pluralism with objective error and direct relevance to the pro burden, while withholding higher credit because the warrant from vivid metaphor to reliable moral classification remains incomplete.
repairs.rationale: This source-specific critique explains the conceptual achievement, evidential limitation, live burden, and locked score without altering the judgment.
